findings.evidence: Interior.lean:44 `theorem ContMDiffMul.isInteriorPoint {n : WithTop ℕ∞} [ContMDiffMul I n G] (hn : n ≠ 0)`; `grep -rn ': ContMDiffMul' Mathlib | grep instance` returns only Monoid.lean:88 (from ∞), :92 (from ω), :96 (order 0), :102 (2 → 1); ParameterDependence.lean:472 already needs `ContMDiffMul.of_le (m := 1 + 1) (n := minSmoothness ℝ 3) (by norm_num)` by hand, showing the downgrade is not found by instance search.
findings.fix: State at the level of the fact proved: `theorem ContMDiffMul.boundarylessManifold {n : WithTop ℕ∞} [ContMDiffMul I n G] (hn : n ≠ 0) : BoundarylessManifold I G := ⟨ContMDiffMul.isInteriorPoint hn⟩`. Consumers then write `haveI := ContMDiffMul.boundarylessManifold (n := minSmoothness ℝ 3) (by norm_num)`, which is as short as the local-instance attribute and works at every order; update the docstring and the line-25 bullet to say `n ≠ 0` accordingly.
findings.issue: Under-generalized: `boundarylessManifold` assumes `[ContMDiffMul I 1 G]` while `ContMDiffMul.isInteriorPoint` (line 44) supplies the same field for every `n ≠ 0`. Mathlib produces `ContMDiffMul I 1 G` only from `∞`, `ω` and `2` (Monoid.lean:88,92,102) — there is no `3 → 2 → 1` chain as `IsManifold` has (IsManifold/Basic.lean:866,868) — so a `[LieGroup I (minSmoothness ℝ 3) G]` file (Exponential/Derivative/Basic.lean:47) cannot discharge `BoundarylessManifold I G` via `attribute [local instance]` without inserting `ContMDiffMul.of_le` first.

summary: The packaging theorem fixes n = 1 although the underlying `isInteriorPoint` in the same file proves the field for every n ≠ 0 with the identical proof, and instance search has no 3 → 1 chain for `ContMDiffMul`, so the C³ consumers the PR names as motivation cannot use it. The docstring inaccuracy from the prior round is fixed.
